|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Bo-Katan's Gauntlet Starfighter]] (version 2 of 2). Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 24 release sheet<ref name="sheet24-20250202">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2024”; file created 2 February 2025). Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. While Bo-Katan piloting, power +3 and cancels Imperial Barrier. Once per game, may deploy a Mandalorian aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition &lt; 4.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Bo-Katan's Gauntlet Starfighter]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Bo-Katan's Gauntlet Starfighter]] (published 26 December 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Bo-Katan’s Gauntlet Starfighter”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings).
